axis_reference.scope: neutral radioulnar kinematic reference; motion-specific contact validation still required
forbidden_shortcuts: elbow centre to generic wrist centre without matched geometry

DRUJ_contact_reference.method: project the radioulnar reference onto the separately defined anterior/posterior sigmoid-notch rim line
limits: Projection is a kinematic measurement, not proof of congruent cartilage contact.
Do not collapse ulnar head, notch centre, projected point and radiocarpal wrist centre into one marker.

fitting_caution.source_report: Thillemann methods describes a sphere fit from three picked surface points.
fitting_caution.independent_geometric_review: Three points alone leave a family of sphere centres. Adopt no implementation of that description without additional constraints and fit-conditioning/coverage checks. A circle in a defined plane is a different model and must be labeled.

blockers: Matched anatomical surface/centre coordinates in a documented neutral pose.
Independent radius and ulna length definitions with compatible 1.82 m male context.
Source sex-label discrepancy and aligned-extrema length semantics in Hong 2021.
Preserve radiocarpal/midcarpal separation and verify PRUJ/DRUJ congruence.
